newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ASTRA finds oil in Venezuela.
newsitem.headline: ASTRA finds oil in Venezuela.

text.p: ASTRA CAPSA, an Argentine oil company, said it had found oil and natural gas in a Venezuelan oilfield.

The company said in a statement late on Monday that the hydrocarbons were found in Quiamare La Ceiba, an oilfield operated by ASTRA through a service contract granted by Corproven of which the company has a 25 percent interest.
After preliminary tests, the CG-46 exploration well drilled in the area showed hydrocarbons in the following formations:
* CO-3P One with 3.4 million cubic feet of gas a day and 134 barrels a day of 60-degree API condensate at a depth of 6,803 feet.
* AM-DI One at a depth of 4,334 feet with 533 barrels a day of 42.4-degree APR oil with a low gas/oil ratio.
The company is evaluating the results of the discovery, which according to the company's previous estimates will add 12 million barrels of oil of proven reserves.
